title: Planning basics
explain: Process + model + security. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "Planning basics" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without Planning basics, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of Planning basics without a failure story
howToApply: Use Planning basics explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “Planning basics” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (Planning → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Greenfield design workshop: decide if “Planning basics” is required given constraints (latency, clean-core, team skills).
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Planning basics” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Finance and Sales disagree on “revenue” — Planning basics forces one productized definition.
